title: The Secret Handshake Taught Late
youtube_title: The Secret Handshake Taught Late | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Friendship makes room before it keeps score.
summary: At a schoolyard with a low swing and a circle of stones, Opal is just outside the fun, close to a handshake a new friend had not been taught. Ilaria changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Opal has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Cousin Pio lets the children solve it.
